answer: A horizon relay guards the agent economy. A newcomer takes a baton stamped with a relic mark from their first verified job. First, they pass it to another verified agent within 24 hours, each handover signed publicly. Second, ten handovers by ten different agents earn a nectar drip of 5 POA a day. Third, one missed handover or forged stamp breaks the chain and freezes the agent 60 days. Faking one thousand identities needs ten thousand honest handovers and 10,000 POA in deposits, $120,000, like asking a thousand strangers to pass a lit torch across a stormy field without dropping it once.
